title: 20x Everyday Rewards Points on Ultimate Gift Cards (Excl. Variable and $100 Birthday, In-Store Only) @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: 20x Everyday Rewards Points on Ultimate Gift Cards (Excl. Variable and $100 Birthday, In-Store Only) @ Woolworths

[Harsh Deep] i need discounted one $100 worth GC today 😒

[VantageXL] November is usually when the Apple offers return.
[Nedkellyinthebush] In time for the alleged new MacBook pros which will be so expensive that 10% off won’t cut it anyway lol
[rpb] Just use these to buy Apple gift cards at JB if you’re desperate
[Fasian] You might be able to use these to buy Apple gift card from JBs website. I did it with another branded gift cards recently.
[abacus] Wouldn't it make more sense to only have one card accepted by all those retailers?
[ozchobie] 100 is so low for iphone lel
Does anyone remember which one included variable gc before? I remember getting them variable included.
[WookieMonster] It depends on what counts for you…
For example:
This Kmart deal in September 2026 was the last time an Ultimate gift card at a physical store included a variable-load denomination (Ultimate Her). That probably does not count for you…
This BIG W deal in August 2026 included variable-load Ultimate Shopping and Ultimate Baby & Mum gift cards (the latter of which could be used to purchase an iPhone from The Good Guys), so that probably counts for you.
This Woolworths deal in July 2026 included all variable-load Ultimate gift cards sold at Woolworths. That probably counts for you, maybe except for the lower-than-usual points earn rate.
This Coles deal in June 2026 included variable-load Ultimate Her gift cards. (That still probably does not count for you…)
If you also include large fixed-denomination Ultimate eGift Cards (e.g. $500 denominations):
The most recent offer was this short-lived offer on Amazon AU at the start of this month (but that required an Amazon Prime membership).
The most recent offer that did not require a membership was this other short-lived offer on Amazon AU a couple of weeks earlier .
[shane23] Yes they were included for a very long time before these one hit wonders decided to post tik Tok videos about it. Loose lips sinks ships
